_approach: The reload moment itself: bar 1 crash-marks a full groove hit as if inviting the wheel-up, then bar 2 is a continuous snare-and-perc roll climbing from mid-velocity to 127 across all 16 steps with hats doubling alongside — the pre-reload intensity that makes a DJ or MC call for the record to be spun back. Ref: DJ TechTools 'Reload: A History of The Rewind'; Point Blank 'How to Create a Dubstep Drop from Scratch'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
